title: Private Equity, Consumers, and Competition: Evidence from the Nursing Home Industry
near_miss_reason: The underlying design is a staggered binary one (PE buyouts of nursing homes at facility-specific dates 1995-2016, never-treated matched controls, post_lbo_frac equal to 0/1 once the acquisition year event_time==0 is dropped). The Table 2 'main_ATE' columns regress each staffing outcome on the single PE indicator. But every reported column (i) is estimated on a STACKED matched event-window sample with match-group-specific facility FE (snf_id#match_group) and match-group-specific year FE (year#match_group), with control facilities reused across match groups (matching with replacement; MatchIt caliper), and (ii) includes three time-varying market controls. Stacked DiD and time-varying controls are both excluded under PROTOCOL Section 2. Flagged as near-miss because an unstacked TWFE on the matched facility panel without controls could be constructed; note that the stacking, not only the controls, separates this paper from eligibility, so the lead may prefer to downgrade it.
eligible_reason: Not eligible as reported: stacked matched design (match-group-specific unit and year FE), time-varying controls in every column, and most specifications interact PE with HHI terciles (inter_low/mid/high), Post2007/Post2009 indicators (tvar_scrutiny, tvar_star) or both (Table 4 nine triple interactions): subgroup-by-treatment interactions and additional treatment regressors. Treatment variable post_lbo_frac is the fraction of the year after the LBO date (Assembly/megamerge_part2.do lines 53-58); because prepare_data drops event_time==0 it is binary in the regression samples (the code in StarShock.do lines 62-68 checks distinct() and uses factor notation when it is 0/1). Also, the shipped PE deal data (lbo_deal_best_date_synthetic.dta, lbo_cleaned_chainkey_synthetic.dta) and the early OSCAR panel (RawEP_1993to2011_synthetic.dta) are synthetic, and the analysis file MatchedAroundLBO.dta is not shipped.
design_notes: Facility-year panel of US nursing homes (OSCAR/LTCFocus/Nursing Home Compare/POS, 1990s-2019). Treatment: first PE acquisition date (lbo_date) from PitchBook/SDC/Preqin/Irving Levin/Capital IQ; ever_lbo. Matching: R MatchIt 4.5.5 with caliper (RMatching.R) in the year before the LBO; each match_group = one target + matched controls; Matching/match_around_LBO_postR.do builds event_time = year - match_group LBO year and event dummies mn4..mn1, pl0..pl4; HHI terciles (hhi_bin) fixed at match year. Regressions via PE_regress program (Analysis/Programs/diff_reg_program.do line 119): reghdfe y rhs $controls, absorb(snf_id#match_group year#match_group) vce(cluster chain_id). Table 2: main_ATE (PE only) and main_HTE (PE x HHI terciles + i.hhi_bin). Table 3: PE, PE x Post2007, PE x Post2009 + i.hhi_bin. Table 4: PE x {pre07, 07-08, post08} x HHI tercile. Table 5: non-staffing outcomes. Figure 3: event-study with mn4..pl4 (all) and by HHI tercile, reference event year 0 (prepare_data_eventfigure), same stacked FE and controls. Appendix: pre-trend tests, 2005-2007 deal subsample (PE##star), county HHI, matching without replacement.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Many cohorts: LBO years 1995-2016 (prepare_data creates smpl_1995..smpl_2016 cohort indicators); exact count requires the data.
